usedFor: TargetBay holds a store's marketing contacts, and “Create or Update Contact” and “Add Contacts to List” keep audiences current.

bestTemplate.name: “New Deal Won” in Teamgate, then “Create or Update Contact” in TargetBay
bestTemplate.why: A won deal adds or updates the customer as a contact, ready for your marketing lists.

watchOut: “Delete Contact” in TargetBay permanently deletes a contact, so check which one before it runs.
